data.narrative:
Onodrim Industries is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Aistis Šimaitis, Alexander Blessing, and Christian Garrett, having raised €40M to date. The valuation assessment benchmarks against a comp universe of 10 private and 2 public peers in the same sector, including late-stage private companies (UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing) and public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

Two triangulation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression method uses the €40M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding an implied valuation of €100M. The Peer-Median method references three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of €400M (range: €125M–€1.0B), reflecting variability across the Defense & Security landscape at comparable maturity levels.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of €85M (low) to €460M (high), with a median of €250M across both methods. This wide range reflects material uncertainty inherent in early-stage benchmarking, particularly where peer valuations span an order of magnitude. Key uncertainties include the degree to which Onodrim's technology differentiation and capital efficiency justify positioning toward the peer-median versus the stage-progression floor, and whether sector tailwinds in Defense & Security support valuations consistent with higher-end comparables.
